howto.text:
How to try it

• Press Play, then click inside once so it has the keys.
• The sidebar now has Upcoming, Undated, Completed and Trash. ⌃1–9 here (⌘ in the app) open its first nine rows.
• Upcoming: drag a row onto another day, or ⌥⌘↑ ⌥⌘↓ to move it a day. A day's + adds for that day.
• Delete a task, then find it in Trash; ⌘⌫ there puts it back.
• The strip's Sidebar, Upcoming and Both dates switches flip the three choices. ? lists every key.

upcoming.text: Upcoming · each open task on the day it reaches Today, the earlier of its When and Deadline. A deadline on its own day reads “Due”. A day's + (or double-clicking its label) adds for that day. Drag a row onto a day to set When, never past its deadline.

undated.text: Undated · open tasks with no When and no Deadline, grouped by list like Today. Drag reorders within a list; a group's + adds to that list. Giving a task a date takes it out, with a notice and Undo.

completed.text: Completed · every completed task, newest first: a group per day for the past week, then per month, kept forever. Unchecking puts it back in its list after 1.5 s. No +: ⌘N adds in the default list.

trash.text: Trash · deleted tasks, newest first, read-only. Put Back (⌘⌫, the menu, the details' ↶) returns a task to its list at its old place. No “delete forever”: hard deletes are deferred (SPEC §11).

c_sidebar.text: Where the views live. A keeps the views you plan from (⌘1–3) on top and puts history after the lists. B puts all five on top and shows counts; lists start at ⌘6.

c_upcoming.text: How Upcoming groups. A always shows the coming week, empty days as quiet targets for + and drag. B shows only days with tasks, a little further out.

c_both.text: A task with When and Deadline. A shows it once, on the earlier date, with the other as a chip. B also shows a quiet echo on the later date; pressing it selects the task.
